metadata.homeDescription: A collection of free, privacy-friendly utilities that run entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, no tracking.
metadata.toolsDescription: Browse and search all available browser-based tools.

home.title: Browser-based tools that respect your privacy
home.description: Every tool runs locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
home.eyebrow: {count} tools · Open source · Runs 100% in your browser
home.featureNoUploadsDescription: Files are processed on your device and never sent anywhere.
home.featureNoServersDescription: Everything computes locally — open source and auditable.

descriptions.audio: Record, edit, and analyze audio in your browser. Trim clips, detect tempo, split stereo channels, and turn speech into text.
descriptions.crypto: Hash text and files, encrypt data, and generate or verify passwords and keys. Explore browser-based tools for checksums, cryptography, and secure credentials.
descriptions.developer: Inspect archives, format code, generate identifiers, and convert developer configurations. Find browser-based utilities for everyday development tasks.
descriptions.diagram: Preview Mermaid, Graphviz DOT, and BPMN diagrams in your browser. Export supported diagrams as PDF.
descriptions.document: Read and convert documents and presentations in your browser. Preview files, extract content, and export to other formats without uploading your documents.
descriptions.ebook: Read EPUB, MOBI, FB2, and comic archives in your browser. Convert ebooks, edit EPUB metadata, or export book content.
descriptions.geo: View maps and GPS tracks, convert coordinates between reference systems, and work with GeoJSON, GPX, KML, and WKT files.
descriptions.image: Convert, resize, and inspect images in your browser. Optimize image files, view metadata, create barcodes, and work with animated image formats.
descriptions.json: Format, validate, compare, and convert structured data. Work with JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, and CSV using tools that run in your browser.
descriptions.misc: Use your camera, test your keyboard or gamepad, inspect device information, and find browser tools for everyday tasks.
descriptions.network: Look up DNS and IP information, calculate subnets, and inspect certificates. Find tools for network addresses, protocols, and troubleshooting.
descriptions.pdf: Merge, split, inspect, and organize PDF files in your browser. Extract text, convert pages to images, and add page numbers without uploading your documents.
descriptions.random: Generate random numbers, passwords, and BIP39 mnemonic phrases in your browser. Choose a tool and customize its output for your task.
descriptions.spreadsheet: View, edit, and convert spreadsheets and CSV files in your browser. Work with Excel, Numbers, and OpenDocument files, and export tabular data.
descriptions.text: Transform, compare, and analyze text, or validate common identifiers. Find browser tools for encodings, writing, text cleanup, and format checks.
descriptions.time: Convert timestamps and time zones, calculate durations, and work with cron schedules. Plan events and compare dates with browser-based time tools.
descriptions.video: Record your screen, trim videos, extract frames or audio, and convert clips to GIF in your browser.
descriptions.web: Encode and decode data, inspect URLs, generate QR codes, and work with web formats. Explore browser-based utilities for common web development tasks.
